prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1283; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented with concussion symptoms following a side-impact collision at an intersection. Initial complaints included headache, dizziness, photosensitivity, mild neck stiffness, and difficulty concentrating. No loss of consciousness was reported at the time of evaluation, though the patient described brief disorientation immediately after the impact. Neurological examination was largely unremarkable, with mild balance deficits on tandem gait and some reduced performance on cognitive screening. Cervical range of motion was restricted but without focal neurological deficit.

Over the course of ten visits, the patient was managed with graduated rest, activity modification, and a structured return-to-activity protocol. Symptoms were tracked at each visit using a standardized symptom scale, showing steady improvement from the early visits onward. Vestibular and cervical physical therapy exercises were introduced in the middle phase of care, and the patient's balance and concentration scores improved accordingly. At the final visit, headache and dizziness were largely resolved, and the patient was cleared for graduated return to work with ongoing home exercise instructions and instructions to return sooner should symptoms recur.
